ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with an approximate 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; dark pixels dominate the medial zones, while light pixels occupy the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal regions of both lobes feature high-intensity white fields with localized dark circular spots. The medial regions consist of contiguous dark black blobs featuring high-intensity linear streaks. The boundary interface between regions is characterized by a high-frequency mottled pattern.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 40 degrees; depth is significant, though the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with irregular, high-frequency peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude) along the trailing edge; a more pronounced indentation is visible on the upper margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a predominantly convex curve that transitions into a steep upward sweep as it approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, dark circular spots on the white distal background of the left lobe; distal tips of both lobes exhibit dense, irregular clusters of textured pixel masses (barnacles).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity linear disruptions (white rake marks) cutting across the dark central pigmentation of both lobes, predominantly oriented in vertical and diagonal vectors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the lateral tips of both lobes, appearing as yellowish-brown, high-texture pixel clusters that protrude beyond the fluke's structural boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips show heavy bio-fouling or parasitic load, creating an irregular, lumpy silhouette distinct from the smooth trailing edge topography.
